scripts.lint: bun run lint:js && bun run lint:ts
scripts.test:e2e:docker:br: bun run test:e2e:docker:build && bun run test:e2e:docker:run
scripts.test:e2e:docker:build: sudo docker build -t test-e2e_development --build-arg USER_ID=$(id -u) --build-arg GROUP_ID=$(id -g) --target test-e2e_development ..
scripts.test:e2e:docker:run: sudo docker run --rm --add-host=app.localhost:127.0.0.1 -v "$PWD/..:/srv/app" -v "jonas-thelemann_playwright_data:/srv/app/node_modules" -v "$(bun pm cache):/srv/.bun/install/cache" test-e2e_development
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:dev: bun run test:e2e:docker:br bun run --cwd tests test:e2e:server:dev
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:node: bun run test:e2e:docker:br bun run --cwd tests test:e2e:server:node
scripts.test:e2e:docker:server:static: bun run test:e2e:docker:br bun run --cwd tests test:e2e:server:static
scripts.test:e2e:server:dev: cross-env NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3000 PORT=3000 VIO_SERVER=dev bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:server:node: cross-env NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3001 PORT=3001 VIO_SERVER=node bun run test:e2e
scripts.test:e2e:server:static: cross-env NUXT_PUBLIC_I18N_BASE_URL=https://app.localhost:3002 PORT=3002 VIO_SERVER=static bun run test:e2e
